hero_lead: Home-style Ecuadorian cooking in the heart of Coral Gables. Made for the ones who miss it, and the ones about to discover it.
hh_desc: Got something to celebrate? Or need to unwind? Either way, your ñaño saved you a seat. Come in, order a drink, and share a plate of Ecuador.
exp_title: A table you didn’t know you missed.
exp_desc: Some days you want the flavor you grew up with. Some days you want to try something new. Either way, there’s a seat for you.
exp_lunch_desc: Your midday break, the way it should feel. A starter, a main dish, fresh juice, and something sweet to finish, like someone cooked it just for you. From $26.
exp_dinner_desc: Encebollado, fritada, seco de pollo, ceviche and more, made to pass around the table. Come hungry and bring the people you love.
exp_hh_desc: $9 signature cocktails and $7 bites every weekday. Raise a glass to something good, or just to a day that’s finally done.
exp_events_desc: Celebrate with your ñaño. Birthdays, anniversaries, reunions, the big news, it all feels like family here.
rec_desc: A curated introduction to the vibrant heritage of coastal Ecuador. Each dish reflects generational recipes, native spices, and freshest coastal seafood.
dish_encebollado_desc: From traditional Creole cuisine, our fish encebollado with pickled onion and our savory consommé.
dish_camarones_desc: Crispy, golden-fried jumbo prawns seasoned with garlic and coastal citrus, served alongside twice-fried green plantain patacones, ripe avocado, and house dipping sauce.
rec_cazuela_desc: From our Manabí Creole culture, a fish stew with a base of green plantain and peanut.
dish_seco_desc: Tender chicken braised in a savory reduction of herbs, mild spices, and fruit notes with fragrant yellow rice and maduros.
rec_guatita_desc: Stewed tripe with potato and peanut.
dish_ceviche_desc: Coastal shrimp and tender seafood gently cured in freshly squeezed lime and sour orange juice, tossed with red onions and cilantro, accompanied by toasted choclo corn.
dish_fritada_desc: Fried seasoned pork ribs, served with patacón (fried green plantain) and criollo salad.
menu_subtitle: Browse our traditional Ecuadorian coastal dishes, refreshing craft cocktails, afternoon happy hour, and lunch specials directly on Miracle Mile.
lunch_box_desc: Join us on Miracle Mile for our celebrated midday lunch. A complete menu featuring a comforting starter, traditional main plate, fresh natural tropical juice, and dessert or espresso.
lunch_notice_text: Our new executive lunch menu is being updated with our latest seasonal chef selections. Please call us or inquire with our Miracle Mile team for today’s featured daily specials.
hh_banner_title: Afternoon Happy Hour on Miracle Mile
hh_banner_desc: Every weekday afternoon, handcrafted Latin cocktails and coastal bites at special prices from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM.
dish_guatita_desc: Stewed tripe with potato and peanut.
dish_churrasco_desc: Braised beef in savory sauce served with rice, french fries, fried egg, and salad.
dish_yapingacho_desc: Roast pork served with yapingacho potato patties in peanut sauce, chorizo, fried eggs, and avocado salad.
dish_cazuela_desc: From our Manabí Creole culture, a fish stew with a base of green plantain and peanut.
dish_encocado_desc: From the green province of Ecuador and across the Pacific coast, our fresh seafood in coconut sauce.
dish_sango_desc: From our Manabí Creole culture, a fish stew with a base of green plantain and peanut.
dish_patacones_queso_desc: Fried green plantains served with cheese and tartar sauce.
dish_maduros_queso_desc: Fried ripe sweet plantain, served with fresh cheese and guava sauce.
dish_choclo_desc: Roasted corn served with grated cheese and salsa verde.
dish_chaulafan_desc: Ecuadorian wok-tossed seasoned rice packed with tender pork, chicken, shrimp, vegetables, and scrambled egg.
dish_arroz_marinero_desc: (TO SHARE) Sautéed with fresh Pacific seafood, our flavorful coastal seafood rice.
dish_bandera_completa_desc: Guatita, cazuela, encebollado, and shrimp ceviche.
dish_acompanantes_desc: Crispy patacones, sweet caramelized maduros, seasoned lentil moro rice, and traditional savory menestra.
cocktail_nana_desc: Delicate, floral, and finished with a bubble. Our namesake, and the easiest yes on the list
cocktail_canelazo_desc: The drink of cold Andean nights, served ice cold. Same tradition, different city.
banner_micartaya_title: Want to explore our complete catalog?
banner_micartaya_desc: Browse our full digital menu on MiCartaYa for the entire range of ceviches, specialty cocktails, and seasonal dishes.
story_title: Since 2001, the taste of Ecuador, wherever we go.
story_lead: Our encebollado has been celebrated as the best in Europe. Now, we bring that authentic passion to 339 Miracle Mile in Coral Gables.
story_sub: In Coral Gables, our team makes every dish from scratch, honoring the original ingredients: fresh green plantain, roasted peanuts, cilantro, yuca and red onion.
houses_note: Seven houses across four international cities.
sig_01_desc: A fragrant albacore tuna and yuca broth finished with pickled red onions and fresh cilantro. The iconic bowl that built our international reputation.
sig_02_desc: Marinated fried pork ribs, served with patacón (crispy smashed plantain) and criolla salad.
sig_03_desc: Grilled seafood served with your choice of side: patacones or avocado salad.
sig_04_desc: A comforting Manabí-style soup with a green plantain dumpling stuffed with seasoned meat, served in a homestyle broth.
atmo_title: The Warmth of Miracle Mile Meets Coastal Ecuador
atmo_desc: Step off the bustling boulevard into a welcoming dining room designed for conversation, laughter, and long meals with family and friends.
atmo_card1_desc: Comfortable booths and tables bathed in warm ambient lighting.
atmo_card2_desc: Fresh maracuyá juices, Ecuadorian rum, and signature creations.
atmo_card3_desc: Al fresco dining enjoying Coral Gables tropical breezes.
atmo_card4_desc: Generous portions crafted for connection and celebrating together.
feat_1_desc: Enjoy open-air dining along historic Miracle Mile in the heart of Coral Gables.
feat_2_desc: Signature cocktails, craft spirits, Club Verde beer, and natural tropical juices.
feat_3_desc: Spacious seating arrangements designed for family reunions and team celebrations.
feat_4_desc: Real yuca, green plantains, achiote, and fresh seafood imported and prepared daily.
events_desc: We are curating a calendar of live Latin music, cultural celebrations, private pairing dinners, and holiday gatherings on Miracle Mile. In the meantime, our dining room and terrace are available for your private bookings, birthdays, and corporate celebrations.

about_story_caption: Authentic Ecuadorian culinary heritage shared with warmth in Coral Gables.

feat_desc: Family recipes, full plates and people who make you feel at home. Right here in Coral Gables.
team_pillar1_desc: The flavors you grew up with, cooked the way they were taught to us.
team_pillar2_desc: Patient cooking, fresh every day: patacones fried twice, soups simmered slowly, nothing rushed.
